title: PlaceCheckout
description: Command (ADR 0007). Sent by cart-service through its outbox in the transaction that sets the cart CHECKING_OUT (topic = this name, key = cartId). Consumed by order-service (group order-place-checkout). Carries no prices: order-service re-prices from stores-service (BR-ORD-03). Answered by CheckoutPlaced or CheckoutRejected. The same cartId + cartVersion with the same content re-publishes the stored outcome; with different content it is answered CONTENT_MISMATCH and the first checkout is untouched (BR-ORD-05).

customerId.description: The customer who owns the cart (customer-scoped data, system rule 4).

cartId.description: Kafka key. With cartVersion, the idempotency key of the checkout (BR-ORD-05, BR-CRT-04).

requestedAt.description: Time of the first send; re-sends keep it. A command with no checkout for its key and older than the reserve window is answered STALE (ADR 0007). Never later than order-service's clock + 30 s (clock skew); a later one is answered INVALID_REQUEST.

delivery.description: Typed at checkout (BR-ORD-15). Personal data: never logged.

stores.description: One entry per store: order-service creates one order each (BR-ORD-01, BR-ORD-14 limits). A storeId appears once, and a SKU once per store; duplicates are answered INVALID_REQUEST.

quoteId.description: The delivery quote the customer saw (BR-PRC-03); a different fee at placement → DELIVERY_FEE_CHANGED.

sku.description: Matched exactly against the store's SKU codes. 1–100 characters, not blank, no NUL: anything else is answered INVALID_REQUEST (a rejection is stored for good, BR-ORD-05).
